Alex / Marissa — thanks for the ping. Attaching our pen test summary and vuln disclosure/process doc. Quick summary below.

- Penetration testing:
  - Third-party pen test performed annually by an external vendor (last completed June 2025).
  - Scope: public-facing APIs and control plane, core inference runtime, auth flows; no customer data environments were in-scope for that external test.
  - Findings: no active critical findings at time of test; some medium/high findings were remediated within agreed timelines. Full summary attached: Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025.pdf

- Scanning cadence / detection:
  - Internal authenticated scans: weekly (developer-owned), automated via CI; external authenticated scans: quarterly.
  - Static analysis: PR gates on main branches, SAST on a weekly schedule.

- Vulnerability management SLA targets:
  - Critical: initial triage within 4 hours, remediation or mitigation plan within 72 hours.
  - High: remediation planned and prioritized within 7 days.
  - Medium: remediation in next 30 days cycle.
  - Low: addressed in regular maintenance (next quarterly patch window).

- Disclosure and coordination:
  - We provide a redacted vendor pen test PDF for procurement. For detailed issues, we coordinate via secure channel (email + ticketing) and can sign an NDA if required. For public disclosure, we follow coordinated disclosure — typical embargo 90 days unless otherwise agreed. See attached policy: redwood_vuln_disclosure_policy.md

If you want a meeting to walk through the attachments, Marissa’s proposed Wed 10am PT works for me — happy to join.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
